name: medium-research-hashnode
description: Hashnode research with normalized MCP output. Wraps the public Hashnode GraphQL API (POST-only, routed through the shared postJson path) with hashnode_trending (FEATURED feed, optional client-side tag-slug filter), a client-side hashnode_search over the featured feed window, and hashnode_get for a single article with its top-level responses. Runs fully keyless — Hashnode public reads need no credentials, so there is no user_config. Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.
